title: prefill/decode: chunked speculative prefill + stage-overlap kernel scheduler and KV-cache improvements
author: Ethan Miller
description:
Motivation: reduce end-to-end latency and increase throughput for prefill+decode workloads on mixed-length sequences. We observed that large prefill requests block decode GPU kernels and prevent efficient KV-cache reuse across concurrent requests. This PR implements three coordinated improvements: 1) chunked prefill: split long prefill sequences into cache-friendly chunks so KV cache can be materialized and reused earlier; 2) speculative prefill: issue speculative shorter prefill passes to quickly populate hot KV slots for common prefixes while a longer prefill completes; 3) stage-overlap kernel scheduler: enable fine-grained overlap between prefill and decode kernels and prefer kernels that maximize streaming of KV cache and reduce GPU stall time. Changes also include KV-cache manager optimizations and continuous-batching hints to reduce per-token overhead.

Summary of changes: single-line description of major files changed and behavioral impacts. Chunked prefill pipeline added (runtime/prefill/chunked_prefill.cpp/h): orchestrates chunking and incremental KV materialization. Speculative prefill path (runtime/prefill/speculative_prefill.{cpp,h}): triggers quick warm-up prefill when request length > prefill_chunk_size and latency SLOs indicate potential benefit. Kernel scheduler updates (runtime/scheduler/kernel_scheduler.cpp/h): new scheduler heuristics to overlap prefill compute and decode compute, prioritize kernels with smaller scratch memory, and reduce kernel launch overhead for continuous-batching. KV cache manager improvements (runtime/kv_cache/kv_cache_manager.cpp): more efficient indexing and asynchronous materialization APIs. Runtime flags: prefill_chunk_size (default 512 tokens), speculative_prefill_enabled (default true), kernel_scheduler_mode (auto|throughput|latency).

Performance impact (internal perf lab): p50 latency -8% to -12%, p95 latency -12% to -22%, p99 latency -15% to -28% depending on model and sequence distribution. Throughput (tokens/sec) improved +20% for mixed workloads and up to +35% for long-prefill-heavy traces. CPU-side overhead reduced by ~18% due to fewer blocking kernel launches. Cost per effective generated token down by ~10% in our benchmarks.

Compatibility and rollout: changes are backward compatible by default flags. Speculative prefill and chunked prefill are gated behind runtime flags; kernel scheduler defaults to previous heuristic under older deployments. Rollout plan: enable flags in canary pool, monitor per-customer latency SLOs and regression on existing eval prompt sets; if stable, promote to Dedicated pools then hosted tier.

Testing and validation: unit tests for KV-indexing and scheduler heuristics, integration perf tests in perf-lab against 7 model+sequence traces, cluster smoke tests on dedicated GPU nodes. Also includes a small internal benchmark harness update to capture prefill/decode overlap metrics.

Notes: This is the culmination of several ENG tickets and closely related to prior prefill-stage-overlap work (see related PRs). Most changes are additive and guarded by flags. See release_notes for operator-facing configuration and recommended defaults.

review_comments: Priya Shah: Can we add a safety check to ensure speculative prefill doesn't regress very short completions? Suggested: disable when expected decode length < 32 tokens. -- addressed in commit c7d8f22, added explicit early-exit condition.

Diego Alvarez: Kernel scheduler looks good; please add microbenchmarks that show launch reduction numbers. -- responded: added in tests/perf/prefill_decode_bench.py and included results in PR description.

Maya Chen: KV index compaction looks heavy on CPU for very large batches; can we async offload to helper thread? -- responded: moved compaction to background worker and added backpressure to avoid memory spikes (commit d9a1b66).
Priya Shah (LGTM): Verified p95 improvements on the canary pool and verified no regressions on short-sequence evals. Approved for merge.

release_notes:
- Prefill/Decode pipeline optimizations: chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and stage-overlap kernel scheduler.
- Performance: up to 28% p99 latency reduction and up to 35% throughput increase for prefill-heavy workloads.
- Operator flags: prefill_chunk_size (default 512), speculative_prefill_enabled (default true), kernel_scheduler_mode (auto|throughput|latency).
- Rollout: enable in canary, then Dedicated pools, finally hosted tier. Monitor latency/eval regression dashboards.
notes: Related PRs: pr-67890, pr-65421, pr-61358. This PR composes prior work on stage-overlap and kernel scheduler into an end-to-end prefill path. Operators should be cautious enabling speculative_prefill for low-latency short-completion workloads until canary metrics are observed.
